organizationInput.registration: trusted service only; current tenant/app/principal binding is sole open_id source
organizationInput.factsOwner: existing organization facts writer; evidence hook in the same content-lock/CAS/deadline/commit transaction
organizationInput.digest: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the full immutable envelope; observation and registration replay preserve original input
organizationInput.incompleteDirectory: reject; never truncate and claim complete
organizationInput.rateCoordination: one explicit shared owner per tenant/app in one process; multi-instance coordination is a runtime prerequisite
organizationInput.tokenInput: injected trusted supplier and per-lease identity; no environment or token endpoint in this candidate
organizationInput.realTenantProof: not established by token supplier alone

transaction.unknownCommit: preserve original receipt/envelope; no ROLLBACK claimed after COMMIT begins
transaction.poolOwner: application assembly owns pools; business service borrows business, terminal failure borrows worker, usage and organization remain separate

serviceIdentity.session_user: dedicated environment LOGIN NOINHERIT without elevated role flags
serviceIdentity.current_user: exactly one NOLOGIN capability via controlled SET ROLE
serviceIdentity.membership: exactly that capability, no admin option, no function-owner membership
serviceIdentity.endUser: authenticated private product session bound by trusted service; DB purpose credentials are not user identity
